```sql
SELECT sum(
    CASE 
        WHEN a.currency = 'AUD' THEN a.spend_local * coalesce(f.aud_nzd_rate, 1.0)
        ELSE a.spend_local 
    END
) AS answer
FROM staging.stg_marketing__ad_spend a
LEFT JOIN staging.stg_erp__fx_rates f ON a.spend_date = f.rate_date
JOIN reference.regions r ON a.region_code = r.region_code
WHERE a.spend_date >= '2025-04-01' 
  AND a.spend_date <= '2026-03-31'
  AND lower(a.marketing_channel) LIKE '%display%'
  AND lower(r.region_name) = 'auckland';
```
